services.name: Birthday Parties
services.desc: Looking for a new and exciting kids birthday party place in Lancaster? The Turkey Hill Experience will put together a fun day of exploration and birthday activities at one of Lancaster County's favorite family attractions. Just get in touch with one of our party planners and we can take care of everything. All of our birthday packages come with all the essentials for a fun time with the kids. A party room for one hour, a party host, e-mail invitations, paper supplies, t-shirt and pin for the birthday kid, cupcake decorating, Turkey Hill drinks and ice cream, pizza, and of course, admission to the Turkey Hill Experience. You can always add extra items to your party plan. State -- Select

blurb: The Turkey Hill Experience features interactive exhibits allowing you to create your own virtual ice cream flavor, package, and commercial. Enjoy plenty of unlimited samples of iced tea and ice cream all while learning about Turkey Hill’s history and how our products are made. Enhance your experience by adding on the Taste Lab where you can make your own unique flavor of ice cream.
